source.description:
姚蘇蓉’s 1987 Single Cover

A polished studio portrait features Taiwanese pop singer 姚蘇蓉 smiling softly against a dark backdrop. She wears a white puff-sleeved dress, pearl earrings, and a pearl necklace, embodying the refined elegance of 1980s Mandopop fashion. The vertical text “姚蘇蓉 一千零一夜” in stylized Chinese characters identifies the artist and the album title.

This artwork serves as the cover for her 1987 single “拾回春夢,” as listed on Spotify. The design’s minimalist composition and classic lighting highlight her poised expression and timeless style, reflecting the era’s pop music presentation.

source.description:
想起你的时候 – 姚蘇蓉专辑封面

This vintage album cover showcases Taiwanese vocalist Yao Su Rong in a bright, close‑up portrait. She smiles warmly, wearing a patterned blouse with red floral designs and a neatly styled 1970s updo. The light background highlights her features and the bold typography.

On the left, large blue Chinese characters spell out the album title “想起你的时候,” while her name “姚蘇蓉” is printed in red below. The overall design captures the nostalgic aesthetic of classic Mandarin pop releases from the era.

Yao Su Rong’s 1970s Album Cover

This album cover for “姚苏蓉之歌” features multiple portraits of singer Yao Su Rong framed within a stylized box graphic. Gold Chinese typography announces the title “一份埋藏的心意” and the question “告诉我为什么？,” while swirling orange shapes emerge from the box’s lid. Yao Su-rong’s Elegant Return
